row.body: The pair is streaked with clouded sample jar from treated rows. It was set aside after the flies vanished, before anyone marked the cab unsafe.
row.title: Clouded sample jar by the cab

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

row.body: The kit is unopened. The water bottle has a black line drawn halfway down it and the same line repeated on the charred wall. Whoever marked it was measuring what survived the fire, not treating a burn.
row.title: A waterline after the fire

sidecar.gloss: A personal account or object records an intervention that left part of the account missing.
sidecar.rival_reading: The waterline could document the spread of a farm chemical washed into the building.
